comparison_policy.claim_scope: six completed INSECTS controls, not full-campaign or three-seed generalization
comparison_policy.expected_auroc_addition: new regime scalar must equal trapezoidal area of retained OLD ROC curve; false old unavailable reason removed only in the comparison projection
comparison_policy.lineage_code_changes: code revision/hash and code-derived model identifiers excluded from equivalence; expected revisions checked separately
comparison_policy.numeric_acceptance: exact JSON numeric values; abs_tol=0, rel_tol=0
comparison_policy.probe_manifest_identity: original raw hash integrity checked; comparison identity excludes only its code_sha256 tag, preserving features, labels, episodes, ranges and source identity
